_comment: The office. Deliberately the ONLY thing in this file, and in its own file, so
that changing who distributes prizes is a visible standalone act in the git
history rather than a line buried in an unrelated diff.
Read at runtime like the rest of Config, so a change here takes effect on edit.
KNOWN LIMIT, accepted rather than solved: this repository is personally owned,
so branch protection exempts administrators by default and naming authorised
pushers is an organisation-only feature. Anyone with write access can edit this
file, including adding themselves. That is why it stands alone: an unauthorised
change is visible as a change to the office.
First entry is the appointed Distributor. The second, if present, is the Deputy,
who exists for exactly one case: issuing when the appointed Distributor is the
Person the Award would name. No Distributor issues to themselves.
